items.prompt: Remove the flames of the Flames and glowing logs inside the stone fireplace.. Show the fuel without flames: the split logs on the grate glowing orange with embers between them and a dark sooty back wall lit warm, in the same chunky pixel art style on the same pixel grid, glowing softly, with the same warm light on the surroundings. No flames, no smoke. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the same painting style, lighting, colors, perspective and level of detail. Do not add any new objects.
